highlights.title: 'I'm built differently' - Hamilton defiant over extending F1 career into 2030s
highlights.summary: Lewis Hamilton insisted he "is built differently" as he continued to rule out extending his Formula 1 career into the 2030s.
body: Following the announcement earlier in October that Africa will return to the F1 calendar at some point in the 2030s with a race in Rwanda, Hamilton had said he hoped he would be able to compete in the first grand prix on the continent since 1993.

Given Hamilton turns 42 in January and will be 45 at the start of the 2030 F1 season, at which point it is far from certain the circuit in Rwanda will be ready, it was initially unclear how seriously his comments should be taken.

But quizzed on the topic on Thursday ahead of this weekend's Mexico City Grand Prix, the seven-time world champion said: "I mean, firstly, you've never had anyone like me here in the 70 years [of the sport's history], so I feel that I'm built differently.

"Of course, there are challenges up ahead that I can't foresee that come with age. But along this way, along this journey, there have been so many preconceived ideas about the fact that your reaction time drops off.
points: Lewis Hamilton insisted he "is built differently" as he continued to rule out extending his Formula 1 career into the 2030s.

highlights.title: Death Stranding Isolations Anime Gets First Trailer
highlights.summary: Kojima Productions revealed the first trailer for Death Stranding Isolations, an original anime series set in the world of Death Stranding, scheduled to release on Disney+ next year. The news was shared in a tweet late on October 29 (the morning of October 30 in Japan).
body: The tweet itself doesn't provide any more clarity; in the post, a quote reads, "My mom became a crater."

Death Stranding Isolations is promised to be an original story driven by its "own unique ensemble of characters," suggesting that Sam Porter Bridges, Fragile, and co. won't be major players in the narrative.

As previously announced, the series will stream exclusively on Disney+ in 2027, though no exact date was given. The anime is directed by Takayuki Sano, known for doing the key animation, as well as designing creatures and props, directing, and many other duties for a swath of major anime over the years. Most notably, he served as the animation director for Attack on Titan's final season, as well as episodes of Jujutsu Kaisen and the movie Jujutsu Kaisen 0.

Tow Ubukata is set to compose the series and its screenplay. Ubukata is a noted science fiction author who lent his talents to Psycho-Pass 3 and Psycho-Pass: Providence, Ghost in the Shell: The New Movie, and was the Free Scenario Plotter for Shenmue.

highlights.summary: Halloween is almost here and with it comes a reliable range of mobile games tapping into the spooky season. In-game events, cosmetics and more can be found across all kinds of genres, as can a sizeable helping of pumpkins, witches and autumnal scenery.
body: Whether it’s Pokémon Sleep turning towards nightmarish ghosts like Gengar, or a growing cast of horror characters in Fortnite, there’s a good chance one game or other will land a scare.

This year, Epic Games, Zynga, The Pokémon Company, Scopely, Intelligent Systems and even The New York Times are among those dressing up their games for the occasion. Many of them also recently landed among our Top 50 Mobile Game Makers of 2026.

The aptly named Fortnitemares event has brought a month of cursed content to Epic Games’ flagship, tapping into a lineup of characters like Freddy Krueger, Ghost Face and Freddy Fazbear. In fact, characters from the Five Nights at Freddy’s universe are going all-in on the fright factor, with their outfits able to show battle damage.

Other IPs trickling in throughout October have included Hollow Knight, Slender Man, Beetlejuice and Obsession. Meanwhile, gameplay has seen players firing pumpkin rockets, teleporting around and dropping into Reload’s Nitemare Island.

highlights.title: Sir Patrick Stewart: Actor who moved effortlessly between Star Trek and Shakespeare
highlights.summary: The English actor began his career on stage before finding fame as the captain of the USS Enterprise.
body: Sir Patrick Stewart, who has died at the age of 86, was a stage and screen great who balanced Hollywood stardom with an equally stellar career in classical theatre.
While many actors are typecast, he moved effortlessly from Shakespeare and Dickens to the command of the USS Enterprise and his famous wheelchair in X-Men.
In a career that spanned seven decades, Sir Patrick received multiple awards, a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame and a knighthood from Queen Elizabeth II.
One of the world's most versatile actors, he mastered both comedy and tragedy, science-fiction and historical drama - despite the entertainment industry's traditional dislike of bald heads.

highlights.title: Everton drop Jack Grealish from Carabao Cup tie over ‘breach of club discipline’
highlights.summary: England player left out of squad to face Newcastle. Moyes confirms he ‘supports’ the club decision. Jack Grealish was dropped from Everton’s Carabao Cup win over Newcastle following a breach of club discipline.
body: Everton took the unusual step of announcing that Grealish’s omission from the fourth-round tie was for disciplinary reasons on social media, after listing David Moyes’s team for the fourth-round tie at Hill Dickinson Stadium. The club posted on X: “Jarrad Branthwaite remains sidelined for a second successive game due to concussion protocols, while Jack Grealish is unavailable for selection due to a breach of club discipline.”
It is understood the 31-year-old missed training on Monday without permission and the decision to drop him was taken by Moyes in conjunction with the Everton chief executive Angus Kinnear.
Speaking after Everton’s 3-1 win, Moyes said: “I’m not going to give any details. It was a club decision and I support it. I don’t want to speak too much about it.”

Grealish returned to training at Everton’s Finch Farm complex after Monday’s absence but is expected to be fined for his unauthorised absence earlier in the week. The playmaker had missed Everton’s defeat at Arsenal on Saturday due to illness.

highlights.title: Attack on Titan 3: The Final Preview
highlights.summary: Attack on Titan 3 may come with a number, but it isn’t a direct sequel in the truest sense of the word. It’s more of a retelling. Based on my time with it, Attack on Titan 3 is juggling a lot of plates, and its ambition to do something new with the franchise is pretty laudable.
body: I must confess something before I get this preview started: I bowed out of Attack on Titan early. After the first season, actually. I didn’t think it was terrible or anything. I was there for the human drama. Little people swinging around like Spider-Man and dealing with their trauma while playing a game of David and Goliath against big, scary Titans. But when those little dudes started being able to become Titans, well… it just wasn’t for me. But after spending some time with Attack on Titan 3 and speaking to producer Hideo Suzuki, I’m tempted to give it another go… at least as a video game.

But I have to get to know these kids, too. Attack on Titan is probably most famous for its high-flying human vs. Titan battles or its knock down, drag out Titan-on-Titan brawls, but it’s a human story at heart, and building relationships with the other characters is a core part of Attack on Titan 3.
points: Attack on Titan 3 may come with a number, but it isn’t a direct sequel in the truest sense of the word.

highlights.title: The Best Top-Handle Bags Will Polish Up Any Look
highlights.summary: Shop our edit of the best top-handle bags—this structured style comes in a variety of sizes, from party purses to large totes—from Coach, The Row & more.
body: No handbag trend was more dominant on the fall 2026 runways than the top-handle. Designers across the fashion capitals sent models down the catwalk carrying purses by one or two short straps, putting the handheld style firmly back in the spotlight. But if the phrase “top handle” still conjures images of overly prim bags that look plucked from another era, this season’s assortment will have you reconsidering the once-retro category.

Rather than adhering to one specific aesthetic, the latest crop of top-handle handbags runs the gamut. There are elongated east-west shapes that tap into one of the year’s biggest accessory trends, alongside more relaxed, but equally of-the-moment slouchy options. Practical shoppers have plenty to choose from, too, thanks to roomy totes and bucket bags that work just as well for a morning work commute as they do for a weekend outing. And, of course, there are still the ladylike versions we’ve long associated with the top handle: refined envelope styles and nostalgic kiss-lock purses that can make even jeans and a sweater look elegant.

highlights.title: Intel says it’s selling every affordable laptop chip it can make
highlights.summary: During Intel's latest earnings call, CEO Lip-Bu Tan said that demand for its budget-focused Wildcat Lake chips "is outstripping supply." According to CFO David Zinsner, the chips are now sold out. Zinsner said Intel has "seen significant growth in Wildcat Lake.
body: Intel’s CFO says it’s ‘not optimistic about next year in terms of memory.’

As shortages of RAM and other components have driven up PC prices over recent months, Intel’s Wildcat Lake chips have been appearing in new lower-cost Windows laptops on par with the MacBook Neo, like the new Dell XPS 13 or the HP Omnibook 5 14. Wildcat Lake laptops like these have budget-friendly starting prices, but often with just 8GB of RAM, which Windows laptops can struggle to get by on.

Intel doesn’t expect the memory shortage to improve any time soon. Zinsner responded to a question about memory supply, saying, “Make no mistake, we are not optimistic about next year in terms of memory.” He added, “we’ll, you know, have to see in ‘28 whether things improve, but our expectation is that it does not improve in ‘27.” That’s more optimistic than SK Hynix’s prediction that the RAM shortage will drag on through 2030.

highlights.title: A Defense Contractor Gave Their Personal AI Agent Access to a Secure Pentagon System
highlights.summary: Sources tell WIRED that an Accenture employee’s personal Claude agent ran on a DOD network for two months before it was identified and the vulnerability could be patched.
body: Earlier this year, sources tell WIRED, a contractor caused a security incident at the Department of Defense by connecting a secure centralized system used by multiple intelligence agencies to their personal account for Claude Code, Anthropic’s AI coding agent. It appears that the agent used by the contractor, who is employed by the global consulting firm Accenture, then sent information about the DOD system, including login credentials, to a high-risk, third-party website.

The centralized system contains controlled unclassified information (CUI), which is considered sensitive and not to be released to the public without review. CUI can include information about critical infrastructure, nuclear submarine propulsion, and vulnerabilities to chemical and biological terrorism. Additionally, security experts say, access to the system could allow for the exploitation of even more sensitive ones.

highlights.title: George Russell determined not to let disappointing F1 season define career
highlights.summary: 28-year-old still believes he will win world title one day. Kimi Antonelli misses media duties with ‘viral illness’ George Russell has insisted he will not let his difficult Formula One season define his career and believes he still has plenty of years left to come back and win the world…
body: Russell has been outdriven by his 20-year-old Mercedes teammate Kimi Antonelli in a bruising season for the British driver. Antonelli is set to win the title and become F1’s youngest world champion at this weekend’s Mexican Grand Prix if he finishes in ninth place or above.

He has taken nine wins thus far to Russell’s three, with the British driver struggling for consistency in adapting to the demands of the energy management required by the new cars which, alongside the tyres in use this year, does not suit the 28-year-old’s driving style.

Russell has delivered some impeccable weekends, including commanding victories in Austria and Baku, but more often than not has been left baffled as to why he cannot make the car work to the same effect as Antonelli, a process which he conceded had been hard to deal with.

“I’ve probably learned more about myself this year than I would have liked to, in all honesty,” he said at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez. “You know, the highs and lows you go through in sport are immense and that’s because we all care so much for what we’re doing.

highlights.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Adds 'Non MilSim Content' Disclaimer to Halloween Themed Content
highlights.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has added new disclaimers to content that may not abide by the game's usual grounded tone and aesthetic. Earlier today, Modern Warfare 4 added a new mode known as Possession.
body: This comes after years of players getting frustrated that Call of Duty's multiplayer often abandons the darker, more serious tone established by the campaign and seasonal lore drops. The franchise has added skins that allow players to play as Nicki Minaj, Beavis and Butthead, and Seth Rogen, which has come at the cost of the game's identity. Infinity Ward already promised to dial things back with Modern Warfare 4 and not include absurd, over-the-top skins, but this new disclaimer does suggest there will be some content that may ride a line for hardcore fans.

Of course, you can also make the argument that Call of Duty isn't realistic and it isn't really a "milsim" game, since it's so fast-paced and filled with ridiculous movement, Wolverine-style health regeneration, and more. It's more of an aesthetic than a style of play. Still, some players value the immersion of more realistic military characters and modes and don't want that disrupted.

highlights.title: More than half of Victorian lawyers use AI – but only a quarter have cut client fees as a result
highlights.summary: Research finds 55% of lawyers are using AI in legal practices, up from 37% last year, though efficiency gains aren’t as high as expected. Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast.
body: More than half of Victoria’s lawyers have reported using AI in their work, according to a new study, but just over a quarter say they have reduced fees as a result of efficiency gains.
They also say clients seeking advice from chatbots have added to their workload, forcing them to correct errors made by AI.

The 2026 census of 2,221 of the state’s lawyers, conducted by the Victorian Legal Services Board and Commissioner’s legal services research centre, found a big increase in lawyers using AI in their practices, rising from 37% to 55% in the last year.
While the 2025 report found AI use was highest among those under 30 years of age, in 2026 this disparity had largely disappeared, although usage remained low for those aged 60 and over.

highlights.title: Gears of War: E-Day Reportedly Sold Over 400K Copies Across Console and PC a Month After Day-One Game Pass Launch
highlights.summary: Sources tell The Verge that Gears of War: E-Day has sold over 400,000 copies across console and PC, and Game Pass is likely to blame. The latest entry in the Gears franchise released to critical acclaim earlier this month, drawing high scores from reviewers and fans alike.
body: However, it seems the title’s popularity isn’t translating to sales — at least, that’s according to a new figure reported by The Verge. Correspondent Tom Warren cited a source who estimated that 400,000 copies of the game have been sold in total across consoles and PC, which paints a grim figure considering the prestige of this particular release.

Data from Alinea Analytics appears to corroborate this thought. As laid out in an October 9 post from the research firm’s head of market analysis, Rhys Elliott, an estimated 1.7 million players accessed E-Day using their Game Pass subscription, rather than buying a copy.

Elliott figured that of those 1.7 million players, likely 722,000 paid for the Premium upgrade, with the game prompting an additional 250,000 Premium upgrades between October 1 and the game’s full release on October 6.

highlights.title: Binance says crypto worth $6.3bn impacted in suspected hack
highlights.summary: The firm said roughly $3bn in assets have been frozen and that it will 'cover all losses'.
body: Cryptocurrency giant Binance said on Thursday that a "security incident" on its platform has impacted about $6.3bn (£4.7bn) of assets.
The world's biggest crypto exchange said about half of those assets have been frozen with the help of other platforms.

Early checks show the suspected hack may have involved an engineer's laptop that had been compromised, which allowed an attacker to make unauthorised withdrawals, Binance said in a series of online alerts, adding that it will "cover all losses".
The incident is potentially the biggest ever crypto heist, eclipsing a record-setting $1.5bn hack on the Bybit exchange in 2025, which was linked to North Korea.

highlights.title: An updated Model Spec for more capable and beneficial AI
highlights.summary: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.
body: As our models get smarter and take more consequential actions in the world, it becomes increasingly important that they go beyond just interpreting the specific instructions they receive. Models also need to understand human intentions and values, so they can exercise good judgment in situations their instructions don’t explicitly address while remaining faithful to human intent and oversight.

Today we’re updating the Model Spec ⁠ (opens in a new window), our public description of how we want our models to behave. The update reorganizes its guidance around five underlying values: faithfulness to human intent, harm minimization, honesty and transparency, human agency, and care. This reflects an aim of our work on value alignment: for models to understand and apply human values in unfamiliar situations, while remaining faithful to human intent. Alongside clearer explanations of existing principles, the revision adds guidance on context, oversight, and agency, adjusts some behavioral defaults, and retires much of the detailed style guidance.
points: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec outlines five core values to guide more capable AI toward sound judgment, human agency, and faithfulness to human intent.

highlights.title: Ireland's Furlong cleared of groin grab by disciplinary committee
highlights.summary: Ireland's Tadhg Furlong is cleared by a disciplinary committee of grabbing Gavin Coombes in the groin during Leinster's United Rugby Championship win over Munster.
body: Munster back row Coombes raised the allegation with match referee Andrew Brace in the first half of Leinster's 24-18 win at Aviva Stadium, but television match official (TMO) Colin Stanley could not find conclusive video evidence.

However, three-time British and Irish Lions tourist Furlong was subsequently cited over an act of foul play under Law 9.27, which says "a player must not do anything that is against the spirit of good sportsmanship including but not limited to grabbing, twisting or squeezing the genitals".

The disciplinary panel, comprised of Simon Thomas (Wales), Attie Heyns (South Africa) and Pamela Woodman (Scotland) met on Thursday and "unanimously concluded the citing complaint against the player should be dismissed, on the basis that he did not commit an act of foul play contrary to Law 9.27".
While they dismissed the complaint, the disciplinary committee concluded Coombes had given "an honest account of his recollection of events surrounding the incident".

Bethesda has also said that, despite teases of a new Fallout game, the studio was still primarily focused on Skyrim 's sequel.

Despite this ongoing radio silence, The Verge reports that Bethesda's marketing is about to turn up a notch. A new dispatch from the tech site claims that Bethesda will officially announce the game's apparent title — The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel — sometime around the fifteen-year anniversary (!) for Skyrim. For those who just turned to dust, Skyrim released on Nov. 11, 2011, so that's coming up.

The report further states that the new Elder Scrolls game will take place in Hammerfell, and that it will cover the history of the Elder Scrolls themselves. Much like in Starfield, players will be uncovering the secrets of mysterious ancient artifacts.

Fashion has long found inspiration from the culinary world, but the influx of food-fueled prints, graphics, and trompe l’oeil accessories that picked up steam during the pandemic have now reached a cultural tipping point.

The then-emerging brand made food a central theme of its vision: Its cake-topped aviator caps, Ferrero Rocher heels, and beeswax-sculpted cheese hats — hyperrealistic, absurdist food designs capable of achieving instant social media virality. highlights.title: Reddit’s CEO says Google’s AI Mode ‘does not drive traffic’
highlights.summary: Reddit CEO Steve Huffman said in an earnings call today that Google's AI-powered search modes do not help with traffic to the platform, echoing problems facing other websites and publishers.
body: Although Google’s AI-powered modes reduce traffic to Reddit, Steve Huffman says that Reddit is still a ‘top search term’ on Google.

“The reality is, AI Mode does not drive traffic,” Huffman says. “Not for us, and not to anybody, as far as I know. That’s just a fundamental shift in how Google works. It used to be a traffic driver, now it’s not.”

He says that AI Overviews and AI Mode have “evolved a lot” and now, at a “minimum,” push “everyone down the search page.” Huffman also says that Reddit believes its content that’s machine-translated into other languages is being ranked lower in search results, which he says would primarily affect the company outside the US.

However, Reddit is still a “top search term in Google,” Huffman says. “This doesn’t say anything about the internet consumers’ demand for Reddit. People still want Reddit. It says Google is not sending them to Reddit the way they used to.” He also says that Google is “crawling us as hard as ever, so the demand hasn’t changed from their point of view, either.”

Russell came into 2026 as favourite after dominating Antonelli last year but has won just three races to his team-mate's nine, regularly being outperformed throughout the season.

"I remind myself I'm 28 years old. I see Lewis still competing extremely well at 41 and Fernando at 44. Lewis won the majority of his titles in his 30s.

highlights.title: Microsoft’s AI future has fewer jobs
highlights.summary: To anyone listening closely to what Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has been saying over the past couple of years, this week felt like the clearest sign yet that AI is about to fundamentally change the size of Microsoft's workforce.
body: It’s also time to name the next Elder Scrolls game, and Xbox’s architect of Forza Motorsport is leaving.

It’s the first time the company has presented such an offer to so many employees, expanding greatly upon the retirement offer that was limited to around 9,000 employees earlier this year. It’s all part of an ongoing effort to avoid reducing investment in AI infrastructure by lowering Microsoft’s operating costs and headcount.

“Our total people costs will go down, our cost per head will go up, and my GPU per researcher will go up,” Nadella said on a podcast almost two years ago, responding to a question about AI’s impact on headcount. That’s a financial way of saying Microsoft will have fewer people, but it will offer higher salaries and more tools and AI power to those who remain.

It also helps explain the continued layoffs we’ve seen at Microsoft over the past couple of years. Microsoft has been performing layoffs regularly over the past decade, but over the past couple of years, the layoffs and executive departures have been significant.

highlights.title: Ubisoft Issues Official Update on Fate of Future Assassin's Creed Remakes
highlights.summary: Ubisoft's latest Assassin's Creed game was a blast from the past. Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced is a remake of the 2013 pirate adventure. As remakes become more and more common in the industry, fans have naturally wondered if more Assassin's Creed remakes are in the pipeline.
body: His use of the plural "remakes" hinted at remakes other than just Black Flag Resynced, but Ubisoft has now confirmed the status of other Assassin's Creed games under active development.

On Thursday, Ubisoft updated fans on the status of the franchise, and touched on fan demand for additional remakes. "One thing we want to be transparent about today is that we currently have no other Assassin's Creed remake actively in development," Ubisoft said. "Our teams are already focused on the next chapter of Assassin's Creed titles, including projects you haven't heard about yet, featuring new settings and stories."

However, just because they're not actively being worked on, don't rule out the possibility of more remakes, or rereleases, sometime in the future. "Like many of you, we love the idea of revisiting our classic titles, and we'll keep exploring opportunities to bring older titles back. That door remains open because, after all... Nothing is true, everything is permitted," Ubisoft said, referencing the oft-repeated Assassin maxim.
